title: The bird on the bare wall
logline: The flyer wall in September, off-season, the flyers curled, and the bird on the shingle between two of them. Nothing to pin, nobody pinning. The bird where the year's count lives, between counts.

panels.composition: A shingle wall with a row of curled paper flyers and the small rainbow bird perched on the shingle between two of them, September light.
